selection_rule.text: 1. Candidate = practice exercise under exercises/practice/* whose slug is NOT one of the 34 polyglot_py slugs (stripping 'pg_' from ~/dev/ops/ref/bm_tasks/polyglot_py dirs and mapping '_' to '-'), has .meta/example.py, a *_test.py test file, a stub file, and .docs/instructions.md. 2. Exclude if the tests, helper modules, or example import anything outside the Python standard library or local exercise modules, or use network/filesystem APIs outside the exercise directory. 3. Validation in isolated temp copies using system python3 (stdlib only): (a) .meta/example.py copied to the stub's module name passes `python3 -B -m unittest <test>` with >0 tests run; (b) the original stub fails at least one test under `python3 -B -m unittest <test>`. Exclude exercises failing (a) or (b) and log the reason. 4. Order all remaining slugs ascending by sha256(slug + ':redo-pypool-2026-11-21') (UTF-8 hex digest) and take all eligible exercises.
